summary: Added Bzip2.Oracle.BitIO (BitReader: readBits ≤32/readBit/readByte/bitPos, Error.eof on short input, reader unchanged on error; BitWriter: writeBits/writeBit/writeByte/finish zero-pads). No per-bit allocation. Moved Error into Bzip2/Oracle/Error.lean (same namespace, API unchanged) to avoid an import cycle; Oracle.lean imports both. Tests (byte-boundary crossings, 32-bit reads, eof, write/read roundtrip of 5000 random widths) run in lake test; verify.sh passes.
followups: Tests live inline in tests/Bzip2/Tests.lean because the bzip2_tests exe has a single root; the golden task may want to add test roots in lakefile.toml.
